Heavy users who run multiple sessions across multiple workspaces at the same time have no"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" way to take in the whole picture at a glance. In particular, once sessions pile up in DSH's native "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"left-sidebar workspaces, the information about active sessions becomes so scattered that it can no l"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"onger answer questions like:
- How many sessions are running in parallel right now?
- Which sessions"},{"id":"p4s6","text":" have spawned sub-agents or even grandchild sub-agents, and how many are there?
- What is each sessi"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"on doing right now? What is its progress? How long has it been running?
- Which model and reasoning "},{"id":"p4s8","text":"level does each session use? What are its output rate, cache hit rate, and token usage?
- Which sess"},{"id":"p4s9","text":"ions have just finished an agent round and are waiting for my action?
- Which sessions have I intera"},{"id":"p4s10","text":"cted with recently? What were the latest instructions and conclusions?
- ..."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This plugin attempts to answer these questions by providing an **activity session overview pane**: r"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"unning sessions, sub-sessions, sessions waiting for action after finishing a round, and recently act"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ive past sessions are brought together and presented as a whole in a single pane."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Mobile dark drawer · light drawer of the same clean isolated environment running a simulated coding "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"le dark drawer · light drawer of the same clean isolated environment running a simulated coding task"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The npm package ships prebuilt, so no local build step is needed. If the pane does not appear after "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"installing, restart `dsh web` once."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web, tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2`.
- No third-party plugin "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"dependencies: the pane only consumes DSH's native session and workspace services, and uninstalling i"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ane only consumes DSH's native session and workspace services, and uninstalling is fully reversible."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Acknowledgments & Disclaimers"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- This project was inspired by the `dsh-answer-pet` plugin: it borrows the session-card design idea,"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" adjusted and re-implemented to fit my own usage habits and preferences. Many thanks to the original"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" author for the creativity!
- The grouping semantics of the collapsed timeline are adapted from the "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"MIT-licensed `dsh-auto-collapse` plugin (a data-layer port with no runtime dependency). Thanks to th"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"e original author.
- The agent-role bot icons on the timeline body rows and recent cards adopt the g"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"eometry of the ISC-licensed Lucide `bot` icon. Thanks to the Lucide contributors.
- 99.99% of this p"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"roject's code and documentation was written and reviewed by AI, so bugs and doc/code drift are quite"},{"id":"p13s8","text":" likely. If you run into any problems, please open an issue."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Adjustments Compared to dsh-answer-pet"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> This project began as a personal re-take on `dsh-answer-pet`, so the checklist below is phrased as"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" a comparison against it — if you have never used that plugin, simply read it as the feature list."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- [x] **From floating overlay to docked pane**: on desktop, a persistent edge-docked column is added"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" to the right of the left-sidebar workspaces; on mobile, a fixed drawer hidden by default is expande"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"d via the "Activity" button in the session header, without squeezing the main conversation layout.
-"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" [x] **No pet icon features**: pet-related features are not supported; the UI focuses on session act"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ivity itself.
- [x] **Native data-source subscription**: directly subscribes to the push snapshots o"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"f DSH's native `sessions` / `workspaces` services; the timeline shows at most 4 collapsed work-item "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"rows, keeping the latest user instruction and the work item actually being executed.
- [x] **Recent "},{"id":"p16s8","text":"session list**: the pane is split into "Active sessions" and "Recent history" areas; inactive main s"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"essions are shown in activity-time batches with both the absolute date-time and the relative activit"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"y time, and a "Load more..." button at the bottom lets users explicitly reveal older sessions.
- [x]"},{"id":"p16s11","text":" **Stronger waiting-for-action reminders**: blocked waits, completion reminders, and error reminders"},{"id":"p16s12","text":" are marked with gold, green, and red cards respectively; questions are previewed directly as a ques"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"tion list, and completion reminders are explicitly acknowledged via the "Move to history" button on "},{"id":"p16s14","text":"the card; the state is persisted on the host side and synced across all clients, so refreshing the p"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"age or opening another window never loses unacknowledged completion reminders or error reminders not"},{"id":"p16s16","text":" yet overwritten by a new round. Each waiting card also shows the relative age of its current state "},{"id":"p16s17","text":"(e.g. "5 min ago") to the right of the status pill, refreshed every minute and hidden when the entry"},{"id":"p16s18","text":" time is unavailable.
